subtitle: Create an item by writing its content, without a book image; students can solve it comfortably on a phone.
loadError: The activity could not be loaded.

kindHints.matrix: Mark the correct option for each row. The T/F template sets up two columns; with multiple choice a row can have several correct options.
kindHints.classify: Sort the cards into groups. A card that belongs to no group is a distractor.
kindHints.order: Write the items in the correct order; students get them shuffled.
kindHints.match: Write the pairs; distractor right items are optional. Students get the right side shuffled.

image.title: Image (optional)
image.hint: Shown below the instruction, not interactive. Up to 5 MB.
image.invalidType: Only image files can be selected.
image.tooLarge: The image can be at most {{mb}} MB.

order.hint: Use the arrows to change the order.

classification.title: Subject / topic (optional)
classification.hint: If you pick a topic it is kept. Otherwise the item is classified automatically from its text.
classification.topicRequired: You picked a subject; pick a topic too.

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: What the student sees. Drag-and-drop cards and the right side of matching are shuffled for the student.

errors.blankColumn: Do not leave an option empty.
errors.blankRow: Do not leave a statement empty.
errors.labelTooLong: Each text can be at most {{max}} characters.
errors.rowWithoutAnswer: Mark the correct answer of every statement (exactly one with single choice).
errors.blankBucket: Do not leave a group name empty.
errors.blankCard: Do not leave a card empty.
errors.noPlacedCard: At least one card must belong to a group.
errors.bucketOverCapacity: A group can hold at most {{max}} cards.
errors.blankItem: Do not leave an item empty.
errors.rightCount: The right side (matches + distractors) can have at most {{max}} items.
errors.blankPair: Fill in both sides of each pair.
errors.blankDistractor: Do not leave a distractor empty.
errors.duplicateRight: Items on the right side must differ from each other.

snackbar.created: The item was added to the activity.
snackbar.saveError: The item could not be saved.
snackbar.classificationError: The item was saved but its subject/topic could not be updated.
